note: Source adaptation: how an UPSTREAM provider's category vocabulary translates into First Step's canonical taxonomy. This is deliberately NOT in taxonomy.json -- 'Housing Assistance' and 'Before/After School Care' are DSCYF's words, not First Step's, and the editorial taxonomy must stay free of any one provider's vocabulary. Keyed by source so a second directory can be adopted without merging its vocabulary into the first and losing provenance. Classification is an INGESTION concern: shared/classification/SourceMappingService loads this file and CategoryClassifier applies it as Tier 1 -- deterministic translation first, keyword inference only for content no mapping covers. Mappings are exact (case-insensitive) matches on the record's raw 'category' field; the raw value is preserved on Resource.category as provenance. Values MUST be category keys that exist in taxonomy.json. See references/decisions.md Decision 034.
